title: Cómic de Boceto Minimalista en Tinta: Visualizando Conceptos Filosóficos
prompt: Minimalist black and white sketch style comic strip page. Expressive, rough, sparse ink lines. High contrast, no mid-tones. Layout: Multi-panel comic with hand-drawn irregular borders. 2D flat perspective with negative space. Subject: A philosophical story about decision making. Panel 1: A character looking contemplative. Panel 2: Doing something happy (reading a book). Panel 3: Doing something difficult (climbing a mountain). Text bubbles in English: 'Two standards for what to do: 1. Things you enjoy and won't regret. 2. Things you might not enjoy but will regret if you don't.' Background: Off-white paper texture. Ink style: Rough, unclosed lines.
